findings.title: Daily publishing is not framed as current activity
findings.evidence: The auto-generated field notes existed, but the main blog page only surfaced them deep in the page.
findings.fix: Add an above-the-fold path and preview area for the latest generated notes.

findings.title: Blog-specific styling fails on the clean URL
findings.evidence: The /blog page resolved blog.css as /blog.css, leaving the page visually unstyled in the clean URL route.
findings.fix: Use absolute blog stylesheet URLs and validate page assets using clean URL resolution.

findings.title: Latest posts are buried below primary scan depth
findings.evidence: The daily notes path appeared far below the hero and featured article grid.
findings.fix: Move a three-post daily preview directly below the hero.

findings.title: The hero lacks clear pathing for different reader intents
findings.evidence: Readers had no immediate choice between latest notes and cornerstone articles.
findings.fix: Add two hero actions: Latest Daily Notes and Cornerstone Articles.

findings.title: Daily notes need clearer public-facing labeling
findings.evidence: The archive label did not clearly explain why generated notes were separate from cornerstone articles.
findings.fix: Label the preview as generated reflections for review, reuse, and professional-development prompts.

findings.title: Validation did not catch clean URL asset failures
findings.evidence: The broken stylesheet path passed existing site checks.
findings.fix: Resolve internal assets against each page's public clean URL during validation.

strategic_moves: Treat /blog as a live publishing surface, not only a static article index.
Keep generated posts visible through an automated preview block on the blog index.
Guard clean URL asset resolution in CI so styling failures cannot ship silently.
